## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> Talk to the WriteStack Coach (Quill), the user's Substack growth coach. It knows their notes, posts, stats, memory, and playbooks. Pass thread_id back to continue the same conversation. The reply is also saved as a Coach chat the user can open at thread_url. This spends the user's Coach allowance.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `string` | Yes | What to ask the Coach, in the user's words, plus any context they gave you. Min length 1. Max length 40000. |
| `skills` | `string[]` | No | Slugs from list_skills to use in this chat. Replaces the skills on in it. Pass an empty list to turn them off. Leave it out to keep them as they are. Max items 5. Max length 40. |
| `thread_id` | `string` | No | thread_id from an earlier ask_coach result. Pass it to continue that conversation. Leave it out to start a new chat. |
